recentItems.title: 🔴 Moses Itauma v Filip Hrgovic LIVE Watchalong, Reaction & Analysis
recentItems.description:
Join BBC Sport live for our watchalong of Moses Itauma vs Filip Hrgovic as one of boxing's brightest young stars faces the biggest test of his career.

Nick Peet is joined by professional boxer Pat Brown and boxing presenter Stephanie Kamale for live reaction, analysis and debate throughout the night. We'll be watching the full MVP card, including Mikaela Mayer vs Chantelle Cameron, before building up to the heavyweight main event between Itauma and Hrgovic.

💬 Get involved in the live chat with your predictions, scorecards and reactions as the action unfolds.

Head to the BBC Sport website and app for more.
